name: Update 0.5
description: Added the ability to use code blocks in chats by using back-ticks (`). As well as this, the fresh new ... news log ... is here, and displays the **latest** and **greatest** updates Whiskers has to offer :shades:

name: Update 0.6
description: A new offline page and server reconnector has been added, now you will no longer need to reload the page every 10 minutes because the server timed out! :euphoric:

name: Update 0.7
description: New reply system, as well as the ability to edit and delete messages!! :happy: As well as this, we did some minor bug fixes, and started work on a couple brand new ... *things*

name: Update 0.8
description: ***BIGGEST UPDATE YET!!! :euphoric:*** Imgur and Tenor intergrations, profile pictures, settings overhaul, media uploads, sorted emojis trey, and, like always, minor bug fixes!

name: Update 0.9
description: Multiple bug fixes, better mobile expierence, multi-lined messages, easier controls, and faster loading times! :shades: As well as this, we did some minor bug fixes, and started work on the last big stretch to make Whiskers fully complete!

name: Update 1.0
description: **Final major update!!!!** Whiskers is officially released! This final update comes with public source code, mobile and desktop downloads, and custom creatable chat room!! :euphoric:

name: Update 1.1
description: Quality of life, bugs and settings updates! Took quite a big break and I really wanna come back to working on Whiskers, expect more updates soon :happy:

name: Update 1.2
description: More themes, multiple bug updates, mobile usability updates, navigation update, and shorter message threshold! :euphoric:

name: Update 1.3
description: Even more themes, PFP decorations, and edited some server code to be easier for future updates :gasp:

name: Update 1.4
description: ***New licence***, PFP cropper, about me, settings layout revamp, profile popouts, and some mobile bug fixes (we are aware of the div message bug and are working our hardest to try and fix it)
